items.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: Because when he came from playing with Chuck, when he came on the gig he says “Rick Montalbano told me—”

ctx.x: Because when he came from playing with Chuck, when he came on the gig he says “Rick Montalbano told me—” I says “you know Rick Montalbano?” And he knew Rick too. Did you guys play together?
Absolutely. A lot of times. Yup. And now I sub for him.
